subject.title: fix(cron): prevent local model preflight socket leaks

question: Which of the two overlapping open cron-preflight socket-cleanup PRs should be the canonical landing path: this expanded test-and-cleanup branch or the earlier related proposal?
rationale: Both branches target the same five-line production behavior and neither is merged; choosing one requires maintainer ownership of the preferred review and attribution path.

options.title: Land this expanded branch
options.body: Prefer this branch because it retains the same bounded cleanup while adding explicit split-stream, rejected-cancellation, and concurrent-stream coverage.

options.title: Land the earlier related branch
options.body: Prefer the earlier proposal if its smaller proof surface better matches the desired maintenance scope, then close this branch as superseded after merge.

recommendation.title: Land this expanded branch
recommendation.body: Prefer this branch because it retains the same bounded cleanup while adding explicit split-stream, rejected-cancellation, and concurrent-stream coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the original documented cleanup approach and real transport proof in the directly related proposal.
